routines.name: current_billing_subscription_for_user
routines.source:
SELECT subscription.*
  FROM public.billing_subscriptions AS subscription
  JOIN public.profiles AS profile
    ON profile.user_id = subscription.user_id
  JOIN public.pricing_configs AS pricing
    ON pricing.is_active = true
   AND pricing.audience = public.profile_pricing_audience(
     profile.role,
     profile.participant_type::text
   )
   AND pricing.key = subscription.plan_key
   AND pricing.module IN (
     'user_subscription',
     'agent_subscription',
     'developer_subscription',
     'professional_subscription'
   )
   AND pricing.metadata->>'stripe_product_id' = subscription.stripe_product_id
  WHERE subscription.user_id = p_user_id
    AND profile.role_switch_in_progress_at IS NULL
    AND subscription.runtime_mode = public.current_billing_runtime_mode()
    AND subscription.livemode = (public.current_billing_runtime_mode() = 'live')
    AND subscription.audience = public.profile_pricing_audience(
      profile.role,
      profile.participant_type::text
    )
    AND subscription.status IN ('active', 'trialing', 'past_due')
    AND (
      p_required_stripe_subscription_id IS NULL
      OR subscription.stripe_subscription_id = p_required_stripe_subscription_id
    )
    AND CASE
      WHEN subscription.status = 'trialing' THEN
        COALESCE(subscription.trial_end, subscription.current_period_end) IS NOT NULL
        AND COALESCE(subscription.trial_end, subscription.current_period_end) > now()
      ELSE
        subscription.current_period_end IS NOT NULL
        AND subscription.current_period_end > now()
    END
  ORDER BY subscription.updated_at DESC, subscription.id DESC
  LIMIT 1
routines.definition:

  WHERE subscription.user_id = p_user_id
    AND profile.role_switch_in_progress_at IS NULL
    AND subscription.runtime_mode = public.current_billing_runtime_mode()
    AND subscription.livemode = (public.current_billing_runtime_mode() = 'live')
    AND subscription.audience = public.profile_pricing_audience(
      profile.role,

routines.name: authoritative_role
routines.source:
WITH caller AS (
    SELECT
      auth.uid() AS uid,
      COALESCE(auth.role(), '') AS jwt_role
  )
  SELECT target.role
  FROM public.profiles AS target
  CROSS JOIN caller
  WHERE target.user_id = _user_id
    AND (
      _user_id = caller.uid
      OR caller.jwt_role = 'service_role'
      OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.profiles AS admin_profile
        WHERE admin_profile.user_id = caller.uid
          AND admin_profile.role = 'admin'::public.user_role
      )
    )
  LIMIT 1

routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.auto_grant_owner_privileges()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_email text := LOWER(COALESCE(NEW.email, ''));
BEGIN
  IF v_email IN ('kr@maiprop.co', 'kostisrenios@gmail.com') THEN
    PERFORM set_config('maiprop.owner_auth_trigger_active', 'true', true);
  END IF;

  IF LOWER(COALESCE(NEW.email, '')) = 'kr@maiprop.co' THEN
    UPDATE public.profiles
    SET role = 'admin'::public.user_role,
        participant_type = NULL,
        updated_at = now()
    WHERE user_id = NEW.id;
  ELSIF LOWER(COALESCE(NEW.email, '')) = 'kostisrenios@gmail.com' THEN
    UPDATE public.profiles
    SET role = 'agent'::public.user_role,
        participant_type = 'agent',
        updated_at = now()
    WHERE user_id = NEW.id;
  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

routines.name: check_ai_call_monthly_limit_trigger
check_ai_quotas_for_user
routines.source:
DECLARE
  v_buckets text[];
  v_runtime_mode text;
  v_is_admin boolean := false;
  v_is_pro boolean := false;
  v_has_free_ai_access boolean := false;
  v_month_start timestamptz;
  v_result jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF _user_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'user id is required' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  IF p_buckets IS NULL
     OR cardinality(p_buckets) = 0
     OR cardinality(p_buckets) > 12
     OR EXISTS (
       SELECT 1
       FROM unnest(p_buckets) AS requested(bucket)
       WHERE bucket IS NULL OR bucket !~ '^[a-z0-9-]{2,64}$'
     ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid AI quota buckets' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  SELECT array_agg(deduplicated.bucket ORDER BY deduplicated.first_position)
  INTO v_buckets
  FROM (
    SELECT requested.bucket, min(requested.position) AS first_position
    FROM unnest(p_buckets) WITH ORDINALITY AS requested(bucket, position)
    GROUP BY requested.bucket
  ) AS deduplicated;

  v_runtime_mode := public.current_billing_runtime_mode();
  v_month_start := date_trunc('month', now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC';
  v_is_admin := public.has_platform_admin(_user_id);
  v_is_pro := public.is_pro(_user_id);
  v_has_free_ai_access := private.has_free_ai_access_for_user(_user_id);

  WITH requested AS (
    SELECT bucket, position
    FROM unnest(v_buckets) WITH ORDINALITY AS value(bucket, position)
  ),
  limits_by_bucket AS (
    SELECT
      requested.bucket,
      requested.position,
      CASE
        WHEN v_is_admin THEN 999999
        WHEN v_is_pro THEN COALESCE(limits.pro_monthly, 0)
        WHEN v_has_free_ai_access THEN COALESCE(limits.free_monthly, 0)
        ELSE 0
      END::integer AS base_limit
    FROM requested
    LEFT JOIN public.ai_usage_limits AS limits
      ON limits.bucket = requested.bucket
  ),
  usage_by_bucket AS (
    SELECT calls.bucket, count(*)::integer AS used
    FROM public.usage_ai_calls AS calls
    WHERE calls.user_id = _user_id
      AND calls.bucket = ANY (v_buckets)
      AND calls.created_at >= v_month_start
    GROUP BY calls.bucket
  ),
  credits_by_bucket AS (
    SELECT
      public.addon_credit_bucket(purchases.addon_key) AS bucket,
      GREATEST(
        COALESCE(sum(
          purchases.credits_granted
          - purchases.credits_consumed
          - purchases.credits_refunded
        ), 0),
        0
      )::integer AS available
    FROM public.addon_purchases AS purchases
    WHERE purchases.user_id = _user_id
      AND purchases.runtime_mode = v_runtime_mode
      AND purchases.livemode = (v_runtime_mode = 'live')
      AND purchases.status IN ('paid', 'active', 'refunded')
      AND public.addon_credit_bucket(purchases.addon_key) = ANY (v_buckets)
    GROUP BY public.addon_credit_bucket(purchases.addon_key)
  ),
  quota_rows AS (
    SELECT
      limits.bucket,
      limits.position,
      COALESCE(usage.used, 0)::integer AS used,
      CASE
        WHEN limits.base_limit >= 999999 THEN limits.base_limit
        ELSE limits.base_limit
          + COALESCE(credits.available, 0)
          + GREATEST(COALESCE(usage.used, 0) - limits.base_limit, 0)
      END::integer AS effective_limit
    FROM limits_by_bucket AS limits
    LEFT JOIN usage_by_bucket AS usage ON usage.bucket = limits.bucket
    LEFT JOIN credits_by_bucket AS credits ON credits.bucket = limits.bucket
  )
  SELECT jsonb_object_agg(
    quota.bucket,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'allowed', quota.used < quota.effective_limit,
      'reason', CASE
        WHEN quota.used >= quota.effective_limit
             AND quota.effective_limit = 0
          THEN 'plan_does_not_include_feature'
        WHEN quota.used >= quota.effective_limit
          THEN 'monthly_limit_reached'
        ELSE NULL
      END,
      'used', quota.used,
      'limit', quota.effective_limit
    )
    ORDER BY quota.position
  )
  INTO v_result
  FROM quota_rows AS quota;

  RETURN COALESCE(v_result, '{}'::jsonb);
END;
routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.check_ai_quotas_for_user(_user_id uuid, p_buckets text[])
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'private'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_buckets text[];
  v_runtime_mode text;
  v_is_admin boolean := false;
  v_is_pro boolean := false;
  v_has_free_ai_access boolean := false;
  v_month_start timestamptz;
  v_result jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF _user_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'user id is required' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  IF p_buckets IS NULL
     OR cardinality(p_buckets) = 0
     OR cardinality(p_buckets) > 12
     OR EXISTS (
       SELECT 1
       FROM unnest(p_buckets) AS requested(bucket)
       WHERE bucket IS NULL OR bucket !~ '^[a-z0-9-]{2,64}$'
     ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid AI quota buckets' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  SELECT array_agg(deduplicated.bucket ORDER BY deduplicated.first_position)
  INTO v_buckets
  FROM (
    SELECT requested.bucket, min(requested.position) AS first_position
    FROM unnest(p_buckets) WITH ORDINALITY AS requested(bucket, position)
    GROUP BY requested.bucket
  ) AS deduplicated;

  v_runtime_mode := public.current_billing_runtime_mode();
  v_month_start := date_trunc('month', now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC';
  v_is_admin := public.has_platform_admin(_user_id);
  v_is_pro := public.is_pro(_user_id);
  v_has_free_ai_access := private.has_free_ai_access_for_user(_user_id);

  WITH requested AS (
    SELECT bucket, position
    FROM unnest(v_buckets) WITH ORDINALITY AS value(bucket, position)
  ),
  limits_by_bucket AS (
    SELECT
      requested.bucket,
      requested.position,
      CASE
        WHEN v_is_admin THEN 999999
        WHEN v_is_pro THEN COALESCE(limits.pro_monthly, 0)
        WHEN v_has_free_ai_access THEN COALESCE(limits.free_monthly, 0)
        ELSE 0
      END::integer AS base_limit
    FROM requested
    LEFT JOIN public.ai_usage_limits AS limits
      ON limits.bucket = requested.bucket
  ),
  usage_by_bucket AS (
    SELECT calls.bucket, count(*)::integer AS used
    FROM public.usage_ai_calls AS calls
    WHERE calls.user_id = _user_id
      AND calls.bucket = ANY (v_buckets)
      AND calls.created_at >= v_month_start
    GROUP BY calls.bucket
  ),
  credits_by_bucket AS (
    SELECT
      public.addon_credit_bucket(purchases.addon_key) AS bucket,
      GREATEST(
        COALESCE(sum(
          purchases.credits_granted
          - purchases.credits_consumed
          - purchases.credits_refunded
        ), 0),
        0
      )::integer AS available
    FROM public.addon_purchases AS purchases
    WHERE purchases.user_id = _user_id
      AND purchases.runtime_mode = v_runtime_mode
      AND purchases.livemode = (v_runtime_mode = 'live')
      AND purchases.status IN ('paid', 'active', 'refunded')
      AND public.addon_credit_bucket(purchases.addon_key) = ANY (v_buckets)
    GROUP BY public.addon_credit_bucket(purchases.addon_key)
  ),
  quota_rows AS (
    SELECT
      limits.bucket,
      limits.position,
      COALESCE(usage.used, 0)::integer AS used,
      CASE
        WHEN limits.base_limit >= 999999 THEN limits.base_limit
        ELSE limits.base_limit
          + COALESCE(credits.available, 0)
          + GREATEST(COALESCE(usage.used, 0) - limits.base_limit, 0)
      END::integer AS effective_limit
    FROM limits_by_bucket AS limits
    LEFT JOIN usage_by_bucket AS usage ON usage.bucket = limits.bucket
    LEFT JOIN credits_by_bucket AS credits ON credits.bucket = limits.bucket
  )
  SELECT jsonb_object_agg(
    quota.bucket,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'allowed', quota.used < quota.effective_limit,
      'reason', CASE
        WHEN quota.used >= quota.effective_limit
             AND quota.effective_limit = 0
          THEN 'plan_does_not_include_feature'
        WHEN quota.used >= quota.effective_limit
          THEN 'monthly_limit_reached'
        ELSE NULL
      END,
      'used', quota.used,
      'limit', quota.effective_limit
    )
    ORDER BY quota.position
  )
  INTO v_result
  FROM quota_rows AS quota;

  RETURN COALESCE(v_result, '{}'::jsonb);
END;
$function$

routines.name: is_pro
routines.source:
SELECT
    public.has_platform_admin(p_user_id)
    OR COALESCE(
      (
        SELECT
          profile.role_switch_in_progress_at IS NULL
          AND profile.force_pro_access
        FROM public.profiles AS profile
        WHERE profile.user_id = p_user_id
        LIMIT 1
      ),
      FALSE
    )
    OR private.has_current_billing_subscription_for_user(p_user_id)
    OR private.has_investor_subscription_for_user(p_user_id)

routines.name: profile_pricing_audience
routines.source:
SELECT CASE
    WHEN p_role IN ('buyer'::public.user_role, 'seller'::public.user_role) THEN 'participant'
    WHEN p_role IN (
      'agent'::public.user_role,
      'developer'::public.user_role,
      'professional'::public.user_role,
      'investor'::public.user_role,
      'institutional'::public.user_role
    ) THEN p_role::text
    WHEN p_role = 'admin'::public.user_role THEN 'agent'
    WHEN p_role IS NULL AND p_participant_type IN ('buyer', 'seller', 'participant', 'pro', 'user') THEN 'participant'
    ELSE NULL
  END

  SELECT CASE

DECLARE
  projected_owner_type text;
BEGIN
  IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
    DELETE FROM public.profiles_public WHERE user_id = OLD.user_id;
    RETURN OLD;
  END IF;

  projected_owner_type := CASE
    WHEN NEW.is_platform_admin
      OR NEW.role::text IN ('agent', 'developer', 'admin')
      THEN 'agent'
    WHEN NEW.role::text = 'seller' THEN 'seller'
    ELSE NULL
  END;

  INSERT INTO public.profiles_public (
    user_id,
    display_name,
    avatar_url,
    first_name,
    last_name,
    role,
    owner_participant_type
  )
  VALUES (
    NEW.user_id,
    NEW.display_name,
    NEW.avatar_url,
    NEW.first_name,
    NEW.last_name,
    NEW.role,
    projected_owner_type
  )
  ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET
    display_name = EXCLUDED.display_name,
    avatar_url = EXCLUDED.avatar_url,
    first_name = EXCLUDED.first_name,
    last_name = EXCLUDED.last_name,
    role = EXCLUDED.role,
    owner_participant_type = EXCLUDED.owner_participant_type;

  RETURN NEW;
END;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.unarchive_role_data(p_user_id uuid, p_role text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF p_user_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'unarchive_role_data_user_id_required';
  END IF;

  IF p_role = 'professional' THEN
    UPDATE public.professionals
    SET archived_at = NULL, updated_at = now()
    WHERE user_id = p_user_id AND archived_at IS NOT NULL;
  ELSIF p_role = 'developer' THEN
    UPDATE public.projects
    SET archived_at = NULL, updated_at = now()
    WHERE owner_id = p_user_id AND archived_at IS NOT NULL;
  END IF;
END;
$function$
